inputs.original_text: Larry Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175 on Thursday, requiring new registrants to prove citizenship to vote in South Dakota state elections. Its narrow limits look less like reassurance than a controlled test: tighten access in one corner, call it routine, and see how much resistance follows. The press release offers assurances but no explanation for why the hurdle was needed. The limited scope may be the point, making the change easier to normalize and expand later.
